C-HISTORICAL-ASSERTION-REVIEW-1-C6AA9BFE.IntentSummary:
T3 plan for C-HISTORICAL-ASSERTION-REVIEW-1-C6AA9BFE, authored from the maintainer-ratified spec (SHA-256 `5667f5c8b88bbde61bbdc2ceb3966b0329c5442d30c43d8c231e168c9a892cd5`, `status` `approved`, permit recorded in the bundle's `run-ledger.xml` at `baseCommit` `3f68a1b351efa58851f2d8245d9a8eb6ad96555b`) at the plan-stage checkpoint `3634516a5c912048634abbd341ad9a6d9120af3d`. Every normative byte-invariance and write-population guard keeps the spec's committed base `3f68a1b351efa58851f2d8245d9a8eb6ad96555b`; only the lifecycle checkpoint (this plan's authoring HEAD) is newer.
**Boundary.** Current workdir XML defines current validation; history is metadata, never mandatory retrospective current compliance. Current obligations (root context, graph, verification, active change bundles, and the selected current close) stay strict; unrelated archived change bundles leave current lint entirely (no error, no warning); historical reads (`change show`, `context --change` on an archive, a bare `review --change`) report supported fields and distinguish `unavailable` from `absent`; historical integrity audits (F286 attempt-pair, F16 relocation/foreign-ID detection) remain informational and non-blocking.
**Owning modules and their verification siblings.** `M-GRAMMAR` (`src/artifact/grammar.ts` and `src/artifact/scope.ts`), `M-QUERY` (`src/query/core.ts`, `src/query/change.ts`, `src/query/render.ts`), `M-LINT-CORE` (`src/lint/core.ts`), `M-REVIEW` (`src/review/core.ts`, `src/review/catalog.ts`), and `M-GATES` (`src/gates/ledger.ts`), paired with `V-M-GRAMMAR`, `V-M-QUERY`, `V-M-LINT-CORE`, `V-M-REVIEW`, and `V-M-GATES`. `.test.ts` paths are not module-ownable write paths, so no synthetic `LINKS:` header or new graph anchor is added for them. `src/grace-context.ts` is deliberately not in scope: the spec records its existing refusal and `unable-to-determine` shapes as the bound historical-context contract, and the unrelated-malformed-archive fix lives in grammar/query.
**Ordering and dependencies.** T-001 removes archived change bundles from current validation (grammar/query/lint) and is the foundation every later task builds on. T-002 makes applied scope credit field-level and is the substrate for the historical view's `unavailable` classification. T-003 adds the `ChangeView` unavailable union and its text/JSON consumers. T-004 turns the archived `MustExist` audit into the `review.historical-path-absent` information notice and registers it. T-005 repairs the T-005 guard and the CLI exit pair, in the same test file T-004 edits, so it depends on T-004. T-006 is the selected-close evidence contract and depends only on T-001; T-007 is the historical-context overturn regression and depends only on T-001; both are independent of the review work. T-008 corrects the `ngrace-plan` rule-19 meaning and its footprint pins and depends on T-005 and T-006 because the corrected text states the audit and close behavior those tasks establish. The three T-001-only tasks (T-006, T-007) plus T-002/T-003 are file-disjoint, but the executor runs the plan serially with no concurrent workers, branches, or worktrees; the dependency edges, not file adjacency, set the order.
**All 18 approved `AC-*` are close-bound with 20 `CloseEvidence` commands**, so no task carries `<Satisfies>`; a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is an error, and this plan adds none.
**Assertions.** `BaselineAssertions` bind only facts the deliverable leaves unchanged: the five module anchors, their `MustVerify` siblings, and stable symbols in the touched files. The deliverable intentionally flips `validateNgraceProject`'s archive walk, the archived-`MustExist` finding code, the rule-19 scratch clause, and the `ChangeView` shape, so none of those pre-edit forms is pinned as a baseline. `TargetAssertions` bind the post-edit facts and carry exactly one `MustPassCommand`, `bun run validate:ci`, driven statically with `--assertions target` (which reports the command unevaluated by design) and then with `--assertions final --run-commands`.
**Close execution order (guidance; the authority owns the real gates).** The close is a two-verdict sequence: pre-archive `ngrace review` supplies findings for `gate verdict`, which permits `gate apply`; `gate apply` and `gate archive` then permit; `ngrace apply` writes applied statuses and moves the bundle into the archive; a post-archive `ngrace gate verdict --change C-ID --outcome pass` evaluates every `CloseEvidence` command in the applied-archive state and records a `Result`/`Exit` pair per criterion through the shipped `ngrace change show`. The post-archive verdict refuses `pass` on any failed or incomplete `CloseEvidence`; the pre-archive verdict does not evaluate `CloseEvidence`. The archive gate requires an empty `run/`, so a terminal cursor event precedes `cursor fold`. Exactly two whole-CI evidence locations exist: the `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` under `--assertions final --run-commands`, and the post-archive `AC-CI-GREEN` `CloseEvidence`. No invocation count is claimed. No record entry is paid and no record XML is flushed; no stash action is authorized.
**`ObservedWriteScope`.** The 22 approved implementation/support/test paths, the active lifecycle artifacts (`run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`, and the `run/**` loose-event glob), and this bundle's own archive arrival glob. The bundle's own `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, and `design-context.xml` are not listed because review skips them by identity; the whole active and archive bundle directories are already excluded by the spec's `AC-WRITE-POPULATION`.

MustContain.Text: archived history is not a current obligation
unrelated malformed archive does not fail the slice
archived existence claim is a historical audit
warning-only review exits zero, errors exit one
selected close refuses empty evidence evaluation

T-001.Title: Remove archived change bundles from current validation in grammar, query, and lint

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/artifact/grammar.ts` no longer emits current-format validation issues for archived change bundles: `validateChangeBundlesInDirectory` skips the archive location (or otherwise excludes it from the returned issues), so an archived spec or plan that is malformed, that declares a non-current `graceVersion`, or that parses with the installed version but omits a current-only required section such as `Summary` contributes no error and no warning. Active change bundles, root context, graph, and verification artifacts are validated unchanged.

`src/query/core.ts` `collectOperationalValidationErrors` extracts assertions and scopes from active plans only, so an unrelated archived assertion defect cannot make `loadGraceArtifactIndex` throw; `ngrace status` and `ngrace context` load with such an archive present.

`src/lint/core.ts` `validateAssertions` no longer extracts or evaluates archived plans in the current lint result; a malformed archived plan produces no `xml.parse` and no `change.applied-plan-missing` lint issue, and a malformed **active** plan still refuses.

`src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` gains a test selectable by `-t "archived history is not a current obligation"` driving the three archived cases on a physical throwaway copy (version change, same-version missing `Summary`, malformed) and proving `bun run ./src/grace.ts lint --path . --fail-on warnings` exits 0 with empty error and warning counts plus byte-exact restoration; and a test selectable by `-t "active stays strict"` proving a malformed active artifact still refuses. `src/grace-query.test.ts` and `src/lint/core.test.ts` gain the index-tolerance and archived-assertion-lint regressions.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/artifact/grammar.test.ts -t "archived history is not a current obligation"
bun test --timeout=0 src/artifact/grammar.test.ts -t "active stays strict"
bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-query.test.ts -t "unrelated archive does not block the index"
bun test --timeout=0 src/lint/core.test.ts -t "archived assertions leave current lint"

T-002.Title: Grant applied-scope credit only from readable scope fields

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/artifact/scope.ts` `collectAppliedChangeScopes`/`readAppliedChangeScope` grants durable and observed scope credit only when the applied archived plan parses and its durable/observed scope fields are readable; an unparsable plan, or a scope field carrying an uninterpretable shape (`scope.invalid-durable-shape` / `scope.invalid-observed-shape` / `scope.invalid-context-artifact`), yields no credit and is distinguishable from a legitimate `declared-none`/empty scope. A readable archived bundle's applied scope still explains drift exactly as today.
`src/artifact/scope.test.ts` gains a test selectable by `-t "unreadable history grants no credit"` driving the readable, unparsable, and unavailable-shape cases and the `declared-none` control.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/artifact/scope.test.ts -t "unreadable history grants no credit"
bun test --timeout=0 src/artifact/scope.test.ts -t "observedWriteScopeContains"

T-003.Title: Add the ChangeView unavailable union and its text and JSON consumers

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/query/change.ts` types `ChangeDurableScope = carried | declared-none | absent | { state: "unavailable"; reason: string }` and `ChangeView.observedWriteScope = ChangeScopeSummary | { state: "unavailable"; reason: string } | null`, with a **nonempty** reason and **no** scope payload on the unavailable member. Selection rules: a supported historical shape yields `carried`/summary regardless of `graceVersion`; a genuine absence yields `absent`/`null`; an explicit `<None />` yields the existing shape (durable `declared-none`, observed empty summary); an uninterpretable shape yields `unavailable` with the reason.

`src/query/render.ts` `formatChangeText`/`formatDurableScope` narrow the union and report the unavailable state and reason distinctly from absent/declared-none; JSON emission (`src/grace-change.ts:118`) carries the exact union member.

`src/query/change.test.ts` is narrowed under the union and gains a test selectable by `-t "historical view unavailable contract"` driving the four controls — known field, explicit `None`, genuine absence, uninterpretable shape — through both real `ngrace change show` JSON and text.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/query/change.test.ts -t "historical view unavailable contract"
bunx tsc --noEmit

T-004.Title: Make the archived MustExist audit informational and register the historical-path notice

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/review/core.ts` `detectConfidentlyWrong` emits `review.historical-path-absent` at `info` for an archived plan's missing `MustExist` (runtime path or change-bundle artifact path), never `review.confidently-wrong`; the same-ID archive alias present is silent, and the missing-both-alias and foreign-id cases are reported as historical notices whose message or explanation contains `archive-time` and `unevaluated`. Active plans keep `review.confidently-wrong` / `must-exist-missing` with the corr-171 same-ID alias resolution, missing-both refusal, and foreign-ID refusal.

`src/review/catalog.ts` registers `review.historical-path-absent` with `severity: "info"` and `family: "process-audit"`; `patternReviewCodes()` still returns exactly the five family-A codes; the info set is exactly `{review.attempt-pair-unpaired-pass, review.historical-path-absent}`; `allReviewCodes()` is 21 and `excludedReviewCodesForLocalization()` is 18. `src/verification/localize.test.ts` count pins are repaired consistently.

`src/review/core.test.ts` gains tests selectable by `-t "current obligations stay strict"`, `-t "archived existence claim is a historical audit"`, `-t "historical integrity audits preserved"`, and `-t "historical-path notice catalog contract"`, and the F286 attempt-pair audit plus the unemitted-marker check keep their codes, severities, and finding IDs.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "current obligations stay strict"
bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "archived existence claim is a historical audit"
bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "historical integrity audits preserved"
bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "historical-path notice catalog contract"
bun test --timeout=0 src/verification/localize.test.ts -t "every REVIEW_CATALOG code is either admissible or excluded"

T-005.Title: Repair the T-005 warning-observation guard and the controlled warning-only/error CLI exit pair

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The test selectable by `-t "T-005 warning remains observable"` drives the real CLI for `C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6`, requires parseable review JSON and exactly one `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` finding whose `file` is the bundle's resolved anchor file (`…/run` or `…/run-ledger.xml`), whose `anchorOrHunkKey` is `attempt-pair:T-005:14->15`, whose `severity` is `warning`, and whose `findingId` matches `^[a-f0-9]{16}$`; it does not assert the process exit status and does not depend on unrelated error counts.

A test selectable by `-t "warning-only review exits zero, errors exit one"` proves a controlled real-CLI warning-only project exits 0 carrying the warning and a controlled current-error project exits 1; `ngrace review` still sets `process.exitCode = 1` only when `summary.errors > 0` and the detector is unchanged.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "T-005 warning remains observable"
bun test --timeout=0 src/review/core.test.ts -t "warning-only review exits zero, errors exit one"

T-006.Title: Close every selected-close empty-evaluation variant in the gate verdict seam

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/gates/ledger.ts` `evaluateCloseEvidenceChildren` / `recordReviewVerdict` refuse `gate verdict --outcome pass` for a bundle resolved under `archive/` unless the spec is readable, uses the `NgraceChangeSpec` root, carries exactly one direct `C-*` wrapper whose tag equals the bundle id, declares `status="applied"`, and has a present, interpretable `AcceptanceCriteria` container with at least one valid `AC-*` criterion. A complete `CloseEvidence` command executes and a non-zero command refuses `pass` with the existing refusal; an incomplete `CloseEvidence` child (no `Command` or an empty `Command`) refuses `pass` rather than being silently uncounted; a missing/malformed container, wrong or missing wrapper identity, unparsable spec, and unavailable applied status all refuse and never fall through to the pre-archive empty-return path. A readable applied wrapper with a valid container and genuinely no `CloseEvidence` criterion still permits `pass`, and the active pre-archive empty path is preserved.

`src/gates/core.test.ts` gains a test selectable by `-t "selected close refuses empty evidence evaluation"` driving the public `gate verdict` across every listed variant, including exact restoration to the base behavior.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/gates/core.test.ts -t "selected close refuses empty evidence evaluation"
bun test --timeout=0 src/gates/core.test.ts -t "permits unable-to-determine"

T-007.Title: Overturn the unrelated malformed-archive context refusal and keep the selected refusal

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/grace-context.test.ts` is updated two-sided: the test selectable by `-t "unrelated malformed archive does not fail the slice"` proves an unrelated malformed archived `spec.xml` leaves the context slice at its exact base output with no lint error or warning, while a **selected** malformed active change still refuses with `invalid-project` / `Unreadable spec at …` and a selected malformed archived change also refuses. `src/grace-context.test.ts` gains a test selectable by `-t "historical context reads supported fields"` proving the concrete required-field responses: unparsable plan/spec refuse with no `issues`, a readable plan with an absent task refuses `not-found`, and a readable spec with no AC body yields the per-criterion `{ verdict: "unable-to-determine", reason }` absence. No archived artifact is rewritten.

Verification.Command: bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-context.test.ts -t "historical context reads supported fields"
bun test --timeout=0 src/grace-context.test.ts -t "unrelated malformed archive does not fail the slice"

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and its packaged mirror `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` are byte-identical; rule 19 no longer contains the claim that an archived plan's `MustExist` raises `review.confidently-wrong` and instead states the `review.historical-path-absent` historical-notice treatment and the selected-close reason for carrying a read-only `.ngrace/scratch`.

`src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts` asserts the corrected rule-19 meaning with a discriminating content check (old clause absent, new treatment present) as well as the re-measured `skillTextLines().total`/`totalBytes`, so an unchanged misleading paragraph with matching byte totals fails. `README.md` contains the same re-measured `**N lines** / **M UTF-8 bytes**` footprint cell and a bounded `ngrace review` note that archived history is audited as historical information. `examples/` is untouched.
